lines: d27: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Aria Walker is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d27: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d27: 🕯️ Aria Walker is dead — sickness. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d27: What Aria kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d27: "Aria's gone." Aki looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Aria." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d27: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Eloá blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d27: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.

d27: 📖 LEARNED: Draw Fire (Level 1). In the wilds, beside your people, you make yourself the problem. Shout, wave, bleed loudly — the beast's eye stays on you and off them. Monsters focus you instead of your allies.
d27: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d27: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d27: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Aria Walker, 27 days. The mantle passes to Eloá Nogueira.
d27: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Eloá Nogueira, 58 — a Vintner. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Echo Location, Berserker Rage.
d27: The village's quarrel was with Aria — and Aria is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d27: At the grave, Kate, Gladys, Wei and 4 more speak for Eloá — "Aria trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d27: The fire knew Eloá before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
